bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are allowed but must be checked in to the cloakroom. Suitcases and holdalls are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at the Accor Arena requires booking in advance online, with a car park located at 85 Rue de Bercy for regular vehicles and another at 8 Boulevard de Bercy for reduced mobility. Vehicle height must be less than 1.90m.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Accor Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Accor Arena offers a variety of food and drink options, including juicy burgers, New York-style hot dogs, and Italian pizza. Vegetarian and vegan options are available at all stands, and visitors can enjoy drinks at the Moët & Chandon, Heineken, and Coca-Cola bars.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Guests with disabilities or reduced mobility can use Accor Arena's dedicated booking service with a disability card or medical certificate. Accessible parking is at 8 Boulevard de Bercy and should be arranged in advance through the venue.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Accor Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Tickets & Collection
ticketPickup.body: Ticket collection at the box office of the venue is not possible.

gates.title: Entrances & Doors
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Accor Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
